why: owner, 2026-10-29: "Verse should learn to rap for those who hear the name and think thats what it is". The rap lyrics generators found by search that day were neuralframes.com/tools/rap-lyrics-generator and notegpt.io/ai-rap-lyrics-generator; neuralframes' page has the fuller form (style, flow, mood, perspective, words to include), so it is the one measured, on Versus' music lane.
rule: Verse assimilates the site: every feature it has, plus one notch, on one page wired into the rest of Verse.

features.theirs: a topic box for what the rap is about
features.plus_one: the topic from the form, or straight from an ask on the stage ('rap about my dog', 'spit some bars about mondays') or a link (?t=)

features.theirs: modern trap, boom bap, drill, melodic, conscious
features.plus_one: the same five, each with its own beat composed in the browser at the style's tempo (boom bap about 90 BPM, trap and drill at half time); drill kept clean

features.theirs: mood (confident, hungry, reflective, party, gritty), flow and perspective choices
features.plus_one: the five moods and funny, three flows that also set how fast the voice raps each bar, and first, second or third person

features.theirs: words or ad-libs to work in
features.plus_one: the same, worked into the bars and passed to the writer as words to include
two 8-bar verses and a 4-bar hook written for the settings, each bar lettered by its end rhyme so the scheme shows, and a line counting bars, rhymed bars and syllables a bar

Perform it: the beat plays and each bar is said on its measure with the browser's own voice, the bar lit as it goes; Rap it yourself plays the beat and lights the bars with no voice; Save the beat as a WAV
Copy the lyrics, and Share this rap puts the whole rap in the link, which opens exactly as written with no model call
Another take, while the same settings bring back the same rap for a week

features.theirs: a hand-off to its paid song generator
features.plus_one: hand-offs to Verse's own free tools: make a song of it on the stage, count the words, translate it, music tools

features.theirs: 3 free generations a day, more on a paid plan
features.plus_one: free with no account; one shared daily cap for the whole site, said plainly when it is reached
